extracted.name: Banana Nut Muffins
extracted.description: These are the most delicious banana nut muffins! Packed with lots of banana flavor and a nutty streusel topping, everyone will ask for the recipe.
instruction_lines: Whisk together dry ingredients, mix together wet ingredients in separate bowls.
Slowly add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix well. Be careful to not over mix. Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix together streusel ingredients until a crumbly mixture forms.
Pour muffin batter into greased baking dish or muffin pan with muffin liners. Top with walnut streusel.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean. Let cool on cooling rack. Enjoy!
